infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Studentkare uses the camera only when you choose to photograph a prescription or health document to add to your records.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Studentkare uses microphone access for secure doctor teleconsultations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Studentkare uses your location only when you tap "Use my location" in Find care, to sort places by distance on your phone. It is never sent or stored.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Studentkare counts your steps with this phone's motion sensor, only after you connect it on the Steps screen. Steps are never turned into a score or shown on shop pages.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Studentkare reads your daily steps and walking distance from Apple Health, only after you connect it on the Steps screen. Nothing else is read.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Studentkare does not write anything to Apple Health.
